title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode20 Ready Steady

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, you were listening?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. I asked Ken to leave his phone on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I bet you're disappointed that the person with the weakest resolve ended up being the one right next to you this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was never able to be as dedicated as you were about chasing your dream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Y'know... I've never seen anyone so crazy that they can practice from morning until night the way you do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought maybe it'd help me be worthy of standing on stage with you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The only skills I have are those I learned from playing classical music. And even that was too much for me, so I ran away.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Practicing like that was the only way for someone like me to have any chance of getting up on stage with someone as serious about their singing as you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're...so serious it's stupid...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's true that I felt like I could be my real self whenever I was singing with you, and I'm thankful for that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But that's all the more reason I can't stay here.
There's nothing more I can do to help you fulfill your dream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is that how you really feel?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...What?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't care what your reasons for starting were or that you were running away from classical music! All that matters is what you really want to do now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You remember right after we formed BAD DOGS when that guy told us we had spirit but no skill?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remember getting really upset, but you never said a thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Friends would normally try to cheer each other up in that sort of situation, but you didn't say a word.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You just kept practicing with me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The look on your face said, We're better than this. We'll show them what we can really do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've only made it this far because you were with me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You love music. So much that it's ridiculous! I know more than anyone how serious you are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The only reason I was able to chase my dream of surpassing RAD WEEKEND was because you were there to listen to me! I don't waver because I know you believe in me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But Akito, I...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shut up with the excuses already!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why can't you get it through your thick skull! I have no intention of teaming up with anyone but you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What do your true feelings tell you right now?
Do you really not want to do this with me anymore?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is there no part of you that wants to get up on that stage with me?! If there is, then somewhere in there you must have the same dream of surpassing RAD WEEKEND that I have!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course I want to!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You have no idea how many times I've thought about just focusing on chasing your dream with you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya... So you finally admit it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If that's what you want, then just do it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nope, that's enough out of you. Stop overthinking every little thing. I want to work with you, and you want to work with me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
All that's left is to realize our dream together.
Isn't that enough?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you...really okay with that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is it really okay for someone with such weak resolve to stand up there with you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Your resolve isn't weak.
You may think it is, but to me, you're the best singing partner a guy could ask for.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you want to do it, then just go for it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...I get it now. So the answer was really that simple all along.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know, for someone who's so good at school, you sure are stupid.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh well.
Starting tomorrow, we're going to be making up for lost time, partner.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then we'll organize an event that'll surpass RAD WEEKEND. Got it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that that's all worked out, can I take your order?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How long have you two been standing there?! Have you been listening this entire time?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're the one who ignored us and just kept talking. Besides, you were on such a roll that we didn't want to interrupt you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm happy for you two.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Aoyagi, this means you'll be able to sing with Shinonome again!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry for making you two worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I've made up my mind.
I'm going to help Akito surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, now! We're the ones who are going to surpass RAD WEEKEND! Don't go getting ahead of yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe!
<So you've finally found them.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did you hear a voice just now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Untitled is flashing again...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Untitled? You guys know about that too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Where are we?
